title: Workspace frame adapter
summary: Validate workspace/v1 and workspace/v2 declarations, preserving preview and timeline, and publish which Panels occupy the frame. v2 additionally pins the Official editor resource tree.

replaceability.why: The adapter and layering machinery are the Host foundation. If this machinery could be replaced by a creator layer, automatic fallback to the original could not be guaranteed. The Lucs carried by open protocols have their own replacement classes.
replaceability.decided: Acrab, self-Luc spec v0.3, 2026-10-18; interface charter rule 6, 2026-10-22

reach.notes: Trusted Host machinery, not authority granted to a Luc. Package calls remain bounded by their resolved permissions, Host APIs and editable scope.

operations.name: compile
operations.notes: No deadline. Requires workspace-frame, the Host product, 1..32 unique module names, core preview/timeline and valid core/native/luc slot fields. ui.mount must be granted; no API or editable authority.

operations.name: compile_package
operations.notes: No deadline. v2 frontend has exactly root, entry=index.html and supported native_api. Pins at most 512 files, each <=16 MiB; v1 compile checks run first.

operations.name: workspace_catalog
operations.notes: No deadline. These codes occur in returned rows, not exceptions. Official workspace sorts first; absent frame mounts nothing, uncontained Panels self-register up to the module limit.

invariants.text: Every compiled frame retains preview and timeline.
Official lumeri.workspace wins frame selection while it is loaded.

break: The operation rejects invalid input, integrity, authority or binding state as described by its operation.

conformance.notes: Existing tests listed here were inspected, not run for this documentation task. The area checker validates the contract files; it does not exercise runtime behavior.
